arxiv-2102-00260.title: On boundaries of geodesically complete CAT(0) spaces
arxiv-2102-00260.creator: Conrad Plaut
arxiv-2102-00260.description: Abstract We give concrete, “infinitesimal” conditions for a proper geodesically complete CAT(0) space to have semistable fundamental group at infinity. 1 Introduction For a CAT(0) space X there is a notion of boundary \partial X ; details are discussed later in this paper, but see also [ 4 ] .

arxiv-2102-13237.title: Graphs of Maximal Energy with Fixed Maximal Degree
arxiv-2102-13237.creator: Octavio Arizmendi
arxiv-2102-13237.description: Abstract We give a bound for the graph energy with given maximal degree in terms of the second and fourth moments of a graph. In the case in which the graph is d d -regular we obtain the bound that is given in Van Dam, E. et al. (2014). through elementary methods.

arxiv-2103-06160.title: Using Cognitive Models to Train Warm Start Reinforcement Learning Agents for Human-Computer Interactions Thanks: This is a preprint of our position paper presented to the "Reinforcement Learning for Humans, Computer, and Interaction (RL4HCI)" workship at ACM CHI2021, https://sites.google.com/view/rl
arxiv-2103-06160.creator: Chao Zhang, Shihan Wang, Henk Aarts, Mehdi Dastani
arxiv-2103-06160.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) agents in human-computer interactions applications require repeated user interactions before they can perform well. To address this “cold start” problem, we propose a novel approach of using cognitive models to pre-train RL agents before they are applied to real users.

arxiv-2104-07810.title: Skeletal Feature Compensation for Imitation Learning with Embodiment Mismatch
arxiv-2104-07810.creator: Eddy Hudson, Garrett Warnell, Faraz Torabi, Peter Stone
arxiv-2104-07810.description: Abstract Learning from demonstrations in the wild (e.g. YouTube videos) is a tantalizing goal in imitation learning. However, for this goal to be achieved, imitation learning algorithms must deal with the fact that the demonstrators and learners may have bodies that differ from one another. This condition — “embodiment mismatch” — is ignored by many recent imitation learning algorithms.

arxiv-2205-00488.title: Towards the structure of a cubic interaction vertex for massless integer higher spin fields E-mail: reshet@tspu.edu.ru
arxiv-2205-00488.description: Abstract The structure of a cubic Lagrangian vertex is clarified for irreducible fields of helicities s 1 , s 2 , s 3 s_{1},s_{2},s_{3} in a d d -dimensional Minkowski space. An explicit form of the operator 𝒵 j \mathcal{Z}_{j} entering the vertex in a non-multiplicative way (examined in [ 6 ] for j = 1 j=1 ) is obtained.

arxiv-2308-05641.title: The White Dwarf Mass-Orbital Period Relation Under Wind Mass Loss August 8, 2026 The White Dwarf Mass-Orbital Period Relation Under Wind Mass Loss – References
arxiv-2308-05641.creator: Shi-Jie Gao, Xiang-Dong Li
arxiv-2308-05641.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shi-Jie Gao, Xiang-Dong Li. Helium white dwarfs (HeWDs) are thought to form from low-mass red giant stars experiencing binary interaction. Because the helium core mass of a red giant star is closely related to the stellar radius, there exists well-known relation between the orbital period ( P orb P_{\rm orb} ) and the mass ( M WD M_{\rm WD} ) of the HeWDs, which is almost independent of the type of the companion star.

arxiv-2310-14378.title: Teleparallel Robertson-Walker geometries and applications
arxiv-2310-14378.creator: A. A. Coley, A. Landry, F Gholami
arxiv-2310-14378.description: Abstract In teleparallel geometries the coframe and corresponding spin-connection are the principal geometric objects and consequently the appropriate definition of a symmetry is that of an affine symmetry. The set of invariant coframes and their corresponding spin connections that respect the full six dimensional Lie algebra of Robertson-Walker affine symmetries are displayed and discussed.

arxiv-2402-03237.title: Declipping and the recovery of vectors from saturated measurements Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification : 42C15, 46T20, 51F30, 94A12 Thanks: The second and third authors were supported by NSF grant 2154931.

arxiv-2402-10260.title: A StrongREJECT ¯ \overline{\hbox{{StrongREJECT}}} for Empty Jailbreaks
arxiv-2402-10260.creator: Alexandra Souly, Qingyuan Lu, Dillon Bowen, Tu Trinh, Elvis HsiehSana PandeyPieter AbbeelJustin Svegliato, Scott Emmons, Olivia Watkins, Sam ToyerCenter for Human-Compatible AI, UC Berkeley
arxiv-2402-10260.description: Abstract Most jailbreak papers claim the jailbreaks they propose are highly effective, often boasting near-100% attack success rates. However, it is perhaps more common than not for jailbreak developers to substantially exaggerate the effectiveness of their jailbreaks. We suggest this problem arises because jailbreak researchers lack a standard, high-quality benchmark for evaluating jailbreak performance, leaving researchers to create their own.

arxiv-2409-13011.title: Stars or gas? Constraining the hardening processes of massive black-hole binaries with LISA
arxiv-2409-13011.creator: Alice Spadaro, Riccardo Buscicchio, David Izquierdo–Villalba, Davide Gerosa, Antoine Klein, Geraint Pratten
arxiv-2409-13011.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alice Spadaro, Riccardo Buscicchio, David Izquierdo–Villalba, Davide Gerosa, Antoine Klein, Geraint Pratten. Massive black-hole binaries will be the loudest sources detectable by LISA. These systems are predicted to form during the hierarchical assembly of cosmic structures and coalesce by interacting with the surrounding environment. The hardening phase of their orbit is driven by either stars or gas and encodes distinctive features into the binary black holes that can potentially be reconstructed with gravitational-wave observations.

arxiv-2410-21023.title: The effect of helium reionization on the Ly α \alpha forest hydrogen flux statistics Thanks: Scottish Universities Physics Alliance
arxiv-2410-21023.creator: Avery Meiksin, Ewald Puchwein
arxiv-2410-21023.description: Abstract We assess the impact of QSOs on the high redshift ( z > 4 z>4 ) Intergalactic Medium using Monte Carlo realisations of QSO populations and the He III \rm\scriptstyle III regions they generate, applied to the Sherwood-Relics simulations, allowing for uncertainties in the QSO luminosity function, its evolution, and QSO spectra and ages.

arxiv-2506-17413.title: Light and Shadow OPEs: A Carroll Symmetric Approach to Flat Holography
arxiv-2506-17413.creator: Sourish Banerjee, Rudranil Basu
arxiv-2506-17413.description: Abstract In this work, we fix the leading term in the operator algebra of light-transformed operators in the context of flat space holography. Starting with light-transformed graviton correlators, we show that the OPE obtained by taking the collinear limit satisfies translation symmetry at the leading order not independently but with assistance from the sub-leading order.

arxiv-2601-07768.title: THETA: Triangulated Hand-State Estimation for Teleoperation and Automation in Robotic Hand Control
arxiv-2601-07768.creator: Akshay Karthik, Alex Huang
arxiv-2601-07768.description: Abstract The teleoperation of robotic hands is limited by the high costs of depth cameras and sensor gloves, commonly used to estimate hand relative joint positions (XYZ). We present a novel, cost-effective approach using three webcams for triangulation-based tracking to approximate relative joint angles (theta) of human fingers.

pmc-11547691.title: Serum Pyridoxal 5′-Phosphate and Pyridoxic Acid Ratio Index with Prognosis of Colorectal Cancer: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-11547691.creator: Xue Li, Lei Xu, Qing-Jian Ou, Huan Xu, Yuan-Yuan Chen, Yu-Jing Fang, Cai-Xia Zhang, Ebba Nexø
pmc-11547691.description: Background: Studies on the association between serum vitamin B6 status and colorectal cancer prognosis are limited and have yielded inconsistent results. This study investigated the association of pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP) and pyridoxic acid ratio (PAr) index with colorectal cancer survival. Methods: A total of 1286 colorectal cancer patients diagnosed since 2010 were selected from the Guangdong Colorectal Cancer Cohort study.

pmc-11675246.title: Genomic Landscape of Chromosome X Factor VIII: From Hemophilia A in Males to Risk Variants in Females
pmc-11675246.creator: Olivia Morris, Michele Morris, Shawn Jobe, Disha Bhargava, Jena M Krueger, Sanjana Arora, Jeremy W Prokop, Cynthia Stenger, Ken-Hong Lim
pmc-11675246.description: Background: Variants within factor VIII (F8) are associated with sex-linked hemophilia A and thrombosis, with gene therapy approaches being available for pathogenic variants. Many variants within F8 remain variants of uncertain significance (VUS) or are under-explored as to their connections to phenotypic outcomes.

pmc-11709985.title: White blood cell types and tau deposition in the medial temporal lobe of cognitively normal older adults
pmc-11709985.creator: Meredith N Braskie, Noelle Lee, Marylan Davison, Victoria R Tennant, Koral V Wheeler, Meral A Tubi, Jamie Terner, Maxwell W Hand, Arthur W. Toga, Sid E. O'Bryant, Kristine Yaffe
pmc-11709985.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) and other dementia risk may be influenced by the immune function and associated with several white blood cell type counts. In cognitively normal Black, Hispanic, and non‐Hispanic white older adults we related three white blood cell types previously associated with AD risk to tau positron emission tomography (PET) values in the medial temporal lobe (MTL), where tau accumulates early.

pmc-13679860.creator: Hossein Akbarialiabad, Ayman Grada, Sancy A Leachman, David Rhew, Alireza Haghighi
pmc-13679860.description: Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping clinical research, diagnostics, health system operations, and medical education. Although not designed exclusively for medicine, these systems increasingly influence clinical applications.
